verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents an official pricing calculator that lets you add and configure products to produce a shareable cost estimate. Its free-program page publishes free credit and free usage limits, so you can estimate a stack before committing. However, the evidence never shows the public per-service pricing pages themselves. Missing for 10: evidence of per-service public pricing pages with rates, depth on calculator coverage across services, independent or hands-on corroboration of estimate accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, prices are published — public per-service pricing pages and an official calculator I can estimate a stack with before signing anything

citations.quote: Add and configure products to get a cost estimate to share with your team.
Get free usage of AI APIs, Compute Engine, BigQuery, and other popular products up to monthly limits—not charged against your $300 free credit.
You won't be charged until you activate your full paid account.
